svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: R — Low-poly crystal · Thrills & Chills round-5 art concept
svg.text: Everything faceted into flat-shaded triangles: a terrain
chunk with a faceted river and waterfall, gem trees and
rocks, a polygon Ferris wheel. Cool morning, pale sky.

g.text: One flat colour per triangle, from its normal.
Light: cool, upper left; shade drifts to slate.
Terrain: 0.5-tile triangle grid, z jitter 5 px.
Riders sit in hex gondolas and coaster cars.
